KA RUKOM THUNC MAWPUD 

Hadien ba la thung ia u Mawpud, ki shong mar shilliang ha la ka 
jong ka liang ki bat kti baroh amgut ha u Mawpud bad ki sa shim 
jingsmai da kine ki kyntien- “Lada ngan tap pudshi khup lane 
shitda, ngan iap khynraw-iap ieng bad lap khlem del por". Baroh 
amgut ki kren ia ki juh ki ktien bad ki sa pynjaw ia ka snam syiar bad 
ka kiad ka urn. Ia kane ka rukom jingsmai la khot “Smai briew- 
smai blei". la kane ka Jutang ki dang bat haduh mynta. 

Ka jfngiadei ki Raid sha RJ-Bhoi bad U Syiem 
(Hima Mylliem-Khyrim) 

Ki Raid sha Ri-Bhoi kim don bynta ne ioh bynta ha ka kam jied 
Syiem thung Syiem bad kim don bynta ruh ha ka kam synshar ne 
bishar. Ha ki por kiba mynshwa la ong ba ki Syiem Hima ki long tang 
ki nongsynshar khlieh briew, kim don bynta ha ki kam khyndew-kam 
shyiap ne kino-kino ki jingmih napoh ki Raid. Hynrei ha kine ki sngi 
kiba mynta ka la long da khongpong. 

Ka Rukom thung Nongsynshar 

Don lai kyrdan ki bor jingsynshar- 

1. Synshar Shnong 

2. Synshar Raid 

3. Synshar Hima 

1 . Synshar Shnong Ia u Rangbah shnong la jied da u Paidbah. 
Hadien ba la jied, ki shnong ki pyntip sha ka Dorbar Raid ba 
kan tip bad aibor ha u ryngkat bad la kyndon trei kam jong uba 
la shna (frame) da ka Dorbar. U Rangbah Shnong u lah ban

2. Ia u nongsynshar ba ha khlieh jong ka Raid, lada dei u Syiem, 
Lyngdoh, Sordar ne u Bangthai, dei ban jied da ka Kur. Hadien 
ba ka Kur ka la jied ka phah ka jingtyrwa sha ka Dorbar. Ka 
Dorbar ka peit bad bishar ia uta u briew, la uba don ka bud 
nam-sniew ne uba bha. Lada um don kano-kano ka bud-nam 
sniew ka Dorbar ka pdiang bad ka pyntip sha ka Kur bad ban 
buh ia ka tarik ban ai noh ha u ia ka spong ka phali. 

Ia ki Longsan ruh kumjuh, ka Kur kan jied bad tyrwa sha ka 
Dorbar Raid. Ka Dorbar kan peit bniah bad pyntip sha ka Kur ban ai 
noh ia ka spong ka phali. Lada ki long ki briew kiba don ka bud-nam 
sniew ka Dorbar ka don ka hok ban kyntait bad pyntip sha ka Kur. 

Ia ka jinglong Longsan ne Long-syiem ym lah ban pynkheifi ne 
pynduh lait noh na kano-kano ka daw bym lah kiar, namar ki long ki 
nongsynshar Riti kiba dei ban neh haduh ka jingiap. 

Ym lah ban thung ne jied ia ki Rangbah Shnong ne Nongsynshar 
Raid da ki Soh Shnong. Dei ban jied da ki Trai ri Trai Raid, khamtam 
ki nongsynshar Raid dei da ki kur Binong-Bishen. 

Ka Rukom lehniam 

Ha baroh ki Raid ki don ki rukom leh niam kiba iapher kawei ka 
Raid na kawei pat, namar ki don la ki jong ki Rangku ki Basa, ki 
blei ki dken ba ki mane ban ainguh aidem ban ai-bam ai-sa bad ban

pynsngewbha ia kita ki blei jong ki. Baroh ki Raid ki don la ki jong ki 
Diri-Dikhnong ki nongpyndep niam. Kine ki Diri ki mih na ka jinghiar 
pateng lada dei ha ka Raid ne ka Kur. Ki don ruh ki Sad Raid bad 
Sad Kur bad dei na ka iing jong kita ki Sad ba kin mih ne pynkhreh 
shwa ban leit sha Dewan Raid. 

( SohShnong - ki briew kiba wan shong-thap shong-bi hapoh ka 
shnong ne Raid). (Binong-Bishen- Ki kur kiba don ki kpep ne 
Mawshyieng hapoh ka Raid).

Ka rukom kheifi jaid 

Ha baroh ki Raid ha Ri-Bhoi Idba dei ki khun Khasi-khara ki 
kheifi jaid sha ka kynthei. Wat ka Raid Mamgar ki ai jaid ne shim jaid 
sha ka kynthei. Baroh ki khun kynthei ki ioh la ka jong ka bhah ka 
bynta bad ia ka dew tymmen jong ki kmie ki kpa ne ki meidot padot. 
Tang ka khun khadduh kan ioh kaba kham bun namar kaba dei ban ri 
ban lum ia ki kmie ki kpa haduh ka sngi ka jingiap jong ki. 

Hynrei ki don ki Raid ba la shong tang ki Mikir suda. Kine, ki ai 
jaid sha u shynrang kaba ki khot “Ka niam-Karbi-Kar bak”. la ka 
bynta kaba kham bun u ioh u khun khadduh.
